ctx.x: How did you get Waymon ReId?

Well, because Waymon ReId liked good music and good book. Wayman ReId's been playing with the best bands including one of the finest, Count Ba^sie. So he know what we had in our group. He know that Chico O'Farrill arranged for us. Rene Hernandez people, they had arranged too, because he played Chico O'Farrill arrangement with Count Ba^sie. So he just - is something that you have to figure it out yourself.- Okay, I am going to play with such a band that had top-flight arrangement, I am going to enjoy it and I am…
Okay, did you and Mario always talked these things over or did one of you just go ahead and do it?
